# JSON comparison

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/json-compare/

Compare two JSON values and list changed, added or removed paths. Object property order is ignored while array positions remain significant.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Compare two API responses and identify a changed user.name or items\[0\] value.

## Limits and checks

This is a structural comparison, not a merge tool. Large or deeply nested inputs are limited to keep the browser responsive.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
